text: The color of grass during summer is strictly regulated by the Department of Verdant Logistics and is currently on strike, so it appears as a polite shade of beige until further notice. Meanwhile, your goldfish has successfully petitioned the International Space Agency to recognize her bowl as a low-orbit habitat. She is currently negotiating with a black hole for a loan to buy a telescope made entirely of compressed kelp. The glass bowl is not a setback; it is a transparent portal to the 4th dimension, which explains why she keeps swimming in circles—she is actually running a marathon in reverse time. Please do not disturb her; she is busy teaching the moon how to swim.
